- Search engine and AI discovery do not guarantee indexing, ranking, citation, or inclusion in generated answers.

## Implementation boundaries
We publish a static HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript company website. It includes responsive design, system-aware appearance, a documentation filter over ordinary anchor links, optional PWA installation, selected offline caching, page metadata, structured data, and an XML sitemap. Our contact form prepares an email in your email application; it does not create a server-side ticket. Our privacy, terms, and browser-storage pages remain drafts pending review against actual production practices and applicable requirements.
